title: This game DISAPPEARS if you pause it!
summary: A game-dev video demonstrating a noise shader in Godot where shapes are visible only in motion against animated noise and vanish when the game is paused or screenshotted. The demo is available on GitHub.
why: HN people cite it as the origin of the vanishing-in-a-screenshot effect, used in ideas for captchas and AI-resistant text.

quote.text: I first saw this effect in a video from Branta Games.
